title: Record the actual approval denial reason
goal: Make M6 denial records distinguish policy denial from approval not being granted, without weakening fail-closed behavior.
context: When an ApprovalGate returns false, M6 currently records the policy's original reason (for example, 'explicit approval required') as if that described the outcome. Missing-gate denial is similarly ambiguous.
forbidden_changes: Do not permit execution after a rejected or missing approval gate.
Do not describe a false approval result as user rejection specifically; the gate may represent other no-approval outcomes.
Do not change policy decisions or approval request semantics.
acceptance_criteria: A gate returning false produces actionDenied reason 'Approval not granted' and matching failed observation.
A missing gate produces an explicit reason that no approval gate is configured.
No actionExecuted event occurs after approval is not granted.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Keep all approval failures fail-closed; adjust only denial reason propagation and regression coverage.
